origins.section: A Constant's Data Goes Through the Constructor, So a New Constant Can't Leave It Out
An Abstract Method Makes Every Constant Write Its Own Rule
A Lambda Argument Fits a Formula; a Body Fits a Rule That Needs the Constant
Look a Constant Up by Its Code Through a Map Built After the Constants, and Let It Refuse Duplicates

gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-carrier-without-arguments: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-carrier-without-arguments: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-carrier-without-arguments: Decided. Lines 38-39: the arguments after a constant's name are passed to the constructor. Lines 64-70 show javac rejecting the bare APPLE_PAY ('constructor PaymentMethod in enum PaymentMethod cannot be applied to given types; required: String,long,int found: no arguments'), and line 72 says 'a constant can't exist without its fee'. GLS is the same case.
recorded.prompt:q-vat-band-bodies: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-vat-band-bodies: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-vat-band-bodies: Decided. Lines 135-151: make the fields private 'and the bodies stop compiling'; javac reports 'non-static variable fixedCents cannot be referenced from a static context' (line 139), because 'each body is an anonymous subclass of the enum ... and a subclass doesn't inherit private members'. Summary lines 326-327 say the same. VatBand's bodies read the private field percent by name, so it doesn't compile.
recorded.prompt:q-codec-lambda-level: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-codec-lambda-level: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-codec-lambda-level: Decided. Lines 195-202: 'The lambda can't see the constant it configures. The arguments are evaluated before the constant exists, in a static context', with javac's 'non-static variable code cannot be referenced from a static context'. Reference table line 348 says a lambda argument reading the constant's field gets the same error. Codec's lambdas read level the same way.
recorded.prompt:q-region-shared-code: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-region-shared-code: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-region-shared-code: Decided. Lines 313-314: 'A HashMap filled with put would keep the last constant for "CRD"'. EU_CENTRAL is declared after EU_WEST, and lines 291-292 say the constants are initialised first and values() lists them all, so the later one wins. Summary line 334 repeats 'where put keeps the last one'. Minor gap: the page never states outright that values() returns the constants in declaration order. 'Keep the last' depends on that, but the CARD/CARD_PRESENT example uses the same order.

recorded.prompt:q-carrier-without-arguments:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-carrier-without-arguments:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-carrier-without-arguments:b: Refuted. Lines 64-72: a constant missing the constructor arguments is a compile error ('found: no arguments'), not a constant with default field values.
recorded.prompt:q-carrier-without-arguments:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-carrier-without-arguments:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-carrier-without-arguments:c: Refuted. Lines 28-30: 'the compiler had nothing to say about the switch: default covers every constant, including the ones nobody has written a case for yet.' Line 74 adds that a switch with default stays unchecked.
recorded.prompt:q-carrier-without-arguments:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-carrier-without-arguments:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-carrier-without-arguments:d: Refuted. The build does not succeed (lines 64-72). Lines 25-30 also show that a default branch handles the uncovered constant (APPLE_PAY gets 0) rather than throwing.
recorded.prompt:q-vat-band-bodies:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-vat-band-bodies:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-vat-band-bodies:a: Refuted. Lines 135-151: bodies that name a private field don't compile, so there is no 70.
recorded.prompt:q-vat-band-bodies:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-vat-band-bodies:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-vat-band-bodies:b: Refuted. Same lines, 135-151: the code doesn't compile, so no result such as 0 is produced. The page gives the error, not an initialisation-order effect.

recorded.outcome:q-vat-band-bodies:d: Refuted. Lines 94-102 show constants that pass constructor arguments and also have bodies, e.g. CARD("CRD", 30, 290) { ... }, and the page presents them as working code (output at lines 122-129).

recorded.prompt:q-region-shared-code:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-region-shared-code:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-region-shared-code:a: Refuted. Lines 313-314 and summary line 334: put keeps the last constant, not the first.
recorded.prompt:q-region-shared-code:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-region-shared-code:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-region-shared-code:c: Refuted. Lines 303-314: the duplicate-key IllegalStateException comes from the collector (toUnmodifiableMap), while put silently keeps the last value with no error.
recorded.prompt:q-region-shared-code:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-region-shared-code:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-region-shared-code:d: Refuted. Lines 303-314: CARD_PRESENT("CRD") alongside CARD("CRD") is accepted by the enum itself. The failure comes from the collector, and with put the code runs and keeps the last value, so equal field values are allowed.
